name: Iron Halo
tagline: The booking backbone for studios building legacies, not just filling chairs.
positioning: Iron Halo is the reservation and client platform for independent tattoo studios ready to run like the institutions they're destined to become.

hero.h1: Every booking, deposit, and consult under one gilded roof.
hero.sub: Iron Halo turns the chaos of DMs, sticky-note deposits, and no-show gambles into a calm, deliberate operation worthy of the art you make.

features.title: Deposits that stick
features.description: Collect non-refundable deposits the moment a consult is booked, auto-applied to the final session. No more chasing Venmo screenshots the night before.

features.title: Per-artist calendars
features.description: Give each artist their own bookable calendar with custom session lengths, healing gaps, and flash-day blocks — all rolling up into one studio view.

features.title: Consult-to-chair pipeline
features.description: Track every inquiry from first reference photo to healed reveal, with stencil notes, aftercare templates, and touch-up reminders built in.

features.title: No-show shield
features.description: Automated reminders, waitlist backfill, and deposit forfeiture rules recover the revenue that used to walk out the door.

features.title: Studio revenue clarity
features.description: See per-seat earnings, deposit float, and booth-rent settlements without a single spreadsheet or shoebox of receipts.

features.title: Client vault
features.description: Consent forms, ID scans, allergy notes, and past-work galleries live on each client's profile — pulled up before the machine even turns on.

testimonials.quote: We went from four full-time hours a day on DMs to zero. Iron Halo runs the front desk so my artists can actually tattoo. Deposits alone paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: Booth-rent settlements used to be a monthly argument. Now every artist sees their own numbers and I just approve. It made the studio feel like a real business.
testimonials.name: Deacon Ruiz

testimonials.quote: The consult pipeline is the thing. References, stencil notes, and aftercare all follow the client. My repeat rate is up 30% and clients think we're wizards.
testimonials.name: Priya Chandra
